poll.q: Aaj ki sab se bari khabar kaunsi lagi?

https://www.anews.com.tr/tech/2026/10/06.what: OpenAI EU mein ChatGPT aur Codex ke text mein invisible watermark (textGrain) lagayega — EU AI Act ki requirement. API users globally opt-in kar sakte hain; detector sirf approved researchers ko milega.
https://www.anews.com.tr/tech/2026/10/06.why: EU chahta hai AI-generated text machine-readable tareeqe se pehchana jaye. Lekin watermark foolproof nahi — paraphrasing, editing ya chhota text ise kamzor kar deta hai.
https://www.anews.com.tr/tech/2026/10/06.next: Aane wale hafton mein phased rollout; OpenAI technology ko open-source karne ka bhi plan rakhta hai.
https://www.anews.com.tr/tech/2026/10/06.take: Ab ChatGPT ke alfaaz mein chhupa signal 😅. Assignment copy-paste walon ke liye bura waqt — lekin yaad rakho, watermark milna ye prove nahi karta ke poora text AI ne likha. Technology abhi kaccha hai.

https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business.what: Anthropic ne Cyber Verification Program expand kar diya — vetted security professionals ab Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 aur Mythos 5.1 ko kam safeguards ke sath test kar sakte hain. Pehle Glasswing partners ne April-July mein 129,000+ vulnerabilities dhoondi thin.
https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business.why: AI models ab code likhne aur analyze karne mein itne taqatwar hain ke defenders aur attackers dono ke kaam a sakte hain — Anthropic chahta hai defenders pehle faida uthayen.
https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business.next: Teen tiers (Defense, Red Team, Specialized) ke liye applications open; vetting US government ke sath mil ke hogi.
https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business.take: AI ko hacker bana ke hackers pakro 🕵️. 129,000 vulnerabilities sun ke lagta hai humara internet ab tak kaise chal raha tha? Defensive side par AI ka ye sab se solid use-case hai.

https://www.unite.ai/claude-ai-assistant.what: Claude ab Google Docs, Sheets aur Slides ke andar sidebar add-on ke tor par — public beta, paid Claude plans par. Khula document parh sakta hai, in-place edits, formulas, pivot tables, naye slides — sab file ke andar.
https://www.unite.ai/claude-ai-assistant.why: AI assistants ab apps ke andar ghus rahe hain — tab-switching khatam, kaam wahin jahan file hai.
https://www.unite.ai/claude-ai-assistant.next: Beta limits hain (Firefox nahi, comments nahi parh sakta) — feedback par features barhenge.
https://www.unite.ai/claude-ai-assistant.take: Gemini ke ghar mein Claude ghus aya 😂. Google Docs mein AI sidebar — ab 'khud likho' wali nasihat ka kya hoga? Competition se user jeetta hai, dono try karo.

https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech.what: Microsoft aaj San Francisco mein 2+ saal baad apna bara Windows showcase kar raha hai (10 AM PT / 10 PM PKT) — theme hai local/on-device AI. Satya Nadella aur Nvidia ke Jensen Huang dono stage par honge; RTX Spark wale Surface Laptop Ultra ki pricing expected.
https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech.why: AI ab cloud se nikal ke laptop ke andar aa raha hai — jo company on-device AI jeetti hai, wo agla decade jeetti hai.
https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech.next: Event ke announcements aaj raat ko samne ayenge.
https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech.take: Nadella + Jensen ek stage par — ye AI ka Avengers Endgame hai 👀. Local AI ka matlab tumhara laptop khud sochega. Asal sawal: ye machines Pakistan mein kab aur kis price par ayengi?

https://www.reuters.com/business/media-t.what: FT/Reuters ke mutabiq SpaceX Apollo ki lead mein ~$40 billion raise karne ki koshish mein hai ($10B loans + $30B debt) — sirf Nvidia AI chips khareedne ke liye. Deal 2027 mein close expected; talks abhi early stage par hain.
https://www.reuters.com/business/media-t.why: AI boom ki asal kahani chips hain — compute ke baghair kuch nahi. Morgan Stanley kehta hai 2028 tak AI infra ko $1.5 trillion external financing chahiye hogi.
https://www.reuters.com/business/media-t.next: Talks early stage hain — deal ho bhi sakti hai, toot bhi sakti hai.
https://www.reuters.com/business/media-t.take: $40 BILLION sirf chips ke liye 💀. Hum yahan laptop ki EMI soch rahe hain, wahan Elon chips ke liye mulk khareedne nikla hai. AI race ab paisay ki race hai — aur paisa khatam hone wala nahi.

https://www.business-standard.com/techno.what: 10th India Mobile Congress aaj se New Delhi mein shuru (Oct 7-10) — theme 'Scale Without Boundaries'. Agenda: 6G, AI-native telecom networks, semiconductors, satellite comms, quantum, cybersecurity aur robotics; 20+ global telecom operators shareek.
https://www.business-standard.com/techno.why: Telecom ab sirf calls nahi — AI infrastructure ka backbone hai. Region ki tech direction aise events mein tay hoti hai.
https://www.business-standard.com/techno.next: 4 din mein launches aur policy announcements expected.
https://www.business-standard.com/techno.take: Parosi mulk 6G ki tayyari mein, hum 4G ke signals dhoond rahe hain 📡😅. Lekin seriously — AI-native networks ka matlab agle 5 saal mein internet bilkul badal jayega. Nazar rakho.

https://www.geo.tv/latest/685296-pakista.what: Pakistan ne Fatah-4 ground-launched cruise missile ke extended version ka kamyab test kiya (Oct 6) — advanced avionics aur navigation ke sath extended range par precise strikes. Sadar, PM aur services chiefs ne scientists ko mubarakbad di.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/685296-pakista.why: Indigenous defence capability deterrence mazboot karti hai — jab dushman ko pata ho ke jawab tayyar hai.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/685296-pakista.next: Program tezi se aage barh raha hai — mazeed tests aur validations expected.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/685296-pakista.take: Ghar ka bana missile, ghar ki izzat 🚀. May mein training fire hua tha, ab extended version — matlab kaam tezi se ho raha hai. Defence mein 'made in Pakistan' sun ke fakhar hota hai.

https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.what: Pakistan aur IMF review talks final stage mein — staff-level agreement expected, jis se ~$1.2 billion (EFF + RSF) release ho sakta hai. FBR ne Q1 target beat kiya (Rs3,043 billion) — mini-budget ka khatra tal gaya.
https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.why: IMF ka paisa = investor confidence + rupee stability. Targets poore hona matlab numbers sambhal rahe hain.
https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.next: MEFP finalize hote hi IMF mission ki recommendation; PM se mulaqat bhi expected.
https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.take: $1.2 billion ka cheque almost tayyar 💰. FBR ne target hit kiya — is baar awam par naya tax bomb nahi girega (shayad). IMF khush, market khush, hum dekhte hain.

https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026/10.what: Deputy PM Ishaq Dar ne Vienna mein kaha — Indus ka pani rokna regional peace ke liye khatarnak hoga; PCA ka Aug 31 award kehta hai Indus Waters Treaty fully in force hai, India ka 'abeyance' ghair-qanooni hai.
https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026/10.why: 250 million Pakistanis ka pani, khana aur bijli isi darya se hai — ye existential issue hai, sirf diplomatic nahi.
https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026/10.next: Neutral Expert proceedings aur diplomatic pressure jari rahegi.
https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026/10.take: Pani par jang ke badal 🌊. Dar ne seedha kaha: hamare hisse ka pani chheena to aman khatre mein. PCA hamare haq mein faisla de chuka — ab dekhna ye hai ke international pressure kaam karta hai ya nahi.

https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.what: Daily pricing ke tehet Oct 7 ke liye petrol Rs1.19 mehnga (Rs394.83/litre), diesel Rs1.91 sasta (Rs395.85/litre). OGRA ne 7-day average international prices par revise kiya.
https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.why: Ab roz naye rates — Friday wala rate weekend par same rehta hai. Transport mehnga = har cheez mehengi.
https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.next: Kal phir naye rates — international oil par nazar rakho.
https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.take: Roz naya rate, roz naya sadma 🎰. Petrol Rs394.83 — Rs400 se bas aik kadam door. Bike walon, himmat rakho. Daily pricing ka matlab ab budget banana aur mushkil.

https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.what: KSE-100 ne 2,592.79 points ka jump lagaya (1.56%) — 168,460.10 par band. Wajah: sasta hota international oil aur siyasi tension kam hone ki umeed. Monday ko 2,288 points gira tha.
https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.why: Market mood swings par chalti hai — oil sasta = investor khush, buying wapas.
https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.next: IMF deal aur oil prices agle direction tay karenge.
https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026.take: Kal roye, aaj hasse 📈😂. Pehle 2,288 down, phir 2,592 up — PSX to dil ka mareez bana de. Lesson: panic mein bechne wale hamesha pachtate hain.
